name: bug
description: Something isn't working

name: enhancement
description: New feature or request

name: documentation
description: Improvements or additions to documentation

name: question
description: Further information is requested

name: duplicate
description: This issue or pull request already exists

name: accessibility
description: Barrier affecting people with disabilities

name: refactor
description: Code change that neither fixes a bug nor adds a feature

name: performance
description: Slowness, jank, or excessive CPU/GPU/memory usage

name: area:gameplay
description: Core rules: pieces, rotation/wall kicks, collision, locking, line clearing

name: area:rendering
description: Canvas drawing: board/grid, current piece, ghost piece, next-piece preview

name: area:input
description: Keyboard controls, key bindings, pause/resume

name: area:scoring
description: Score, lines, level progression, drop interval/speed

name: area:ui
description: HTML/CSS layout, styling, on-screen text outside the canvas

name: area:ci
description: GitHub Actions workflows, automation, repo tooling

name: priority:high
description: Breaks core gameplay or blocks users; should be fixed soon

name: priority:medium
description: Noticeable but has a workaround or limited impact

name: priority:low
description: Minor, cosmetic, or nice-to-have

name: effort:small
description: Roughly a few lines / one function, low risk

name: effort:medium
description: Touches a few functions or one subsystem

name: effort:large
description: Cross-cutting change or new subsystem

name: needs-info
description: Not enough information to diagnose; author follow-up needed

name: triaged
description: Automatically analyzed by Claude issue triage

name: skip-triage
description: Excludes this issue from automatic Claude triage
